---
name: Frontend Instructions
description: This file describes the frontend code style and best practices for the project.
applyTo: 'srcs/apps/Angular/**/*.ts,srcs/apps/Angular/**/*.html,srcs/apps/Angular/**/*.scss'
---

<instructions>
1. Do not edit `*proxies.ts` files directly. These files are generated by the `nswag` tool.
  - Start the backend microservices with `dotnet run` at `Aspire` project firstly.
  - Navigate to the `srcs/apps/Angular` directory and run `npm run nswag`.
</instructions>
